name: app-shell
title: App shell
description: The frame of an app: skip link, navbar, sidebar, main and aside in one responsive grid.

css.content:
/* Radix tooltip content. The legacy .tip-wrap/.tip CSS-only tooltip still works. */
.tooltip { z-index: var(--z-toast); padding: var(--s1) var(--s3); background: var(--surface); color: var(--surface-text); font-size: var(--text-xs); max-width: 280px; animation: dialog-fade var(--fast) var(--ease); }

a11y: Landmarks: banner (the navbar), navigation (the sidebar), main and complementary (the aside, named by asideLabel).
The first focusable element is a skip link to the main region; main takes focus when it is used.
The sidebar shows from 800px and the aside beside the page from 1100px; below those they move into a drawer or stack under the page.
scroll="page" keeps the navbar and sidebar in view while the page scrolls; scroll="contained" scrolls the regions on their own.

props.name: navbar
props.description: A `Navbar`. Sticks to the top while the page scrolls.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: A `Sidebar`. Hidden below 800px (its drawer opens from a `SidebarTrigger`).

props.name: aside
props.description: Secondary content in a complementary landmark: a details panel, help, activity. Beside the page from 1100px, below it on narrower screens.

props.name: skipLinkLabel
props.description: Text of the skip link, the first thing a keyboard user can reach. Default "Skip to main content".

props.name: mainId
props.description: The `id` of the main region, which the skip link targets. Default is generated.

props.name: scroll
props.description:
`page` (default): the page scrolls; the navbar and sidebar stay in view. `contained`: the shell fills its height and the sidebar and main scroll on their own.
Set the height with the CSS variable `--app-shell-height` (default full viewport); in `page` mode `--app-shell-min-height` sets the minimum.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Whether the sidebar is collapsed to icons, when controlled. Pair with `onCollapsedChange`.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Whether the sidebar starts collapsed when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called with the new collapsed state. Save it to persist the choice, then pass it back as `defaultCollapsed`.

props.name: children
props.description: The page. Put one h1 in it (a `PageHeader` does).
